title: Holiday Ad Photos and Videos for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Make holiday ad photos and videos from one product photo. Type dates, prices, or offers in the editor, then reuse the scene when those details change.
h1: Create Holiday Ad Photos and Videos Fast
lead: Build the gift scene from the product photo. Type the ship-by date when the carrier confirms it.

faq.q: How do credits work for a holiday photo or video?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. The cost is on screen before the job runs. If it fails, those credits return.

faq.q: Can I add holiday music and seasonal visuals?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a track from the music library, add pictures that fit the season, and put captions on in the editor. Use a track you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make holiday scenes for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links and each one comes back as its own gift scene. You still check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the gift message?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar can read a short gift note beside the product. Keep the product easy to recognize.

faq.q: What happens to the ad after the holiday ends?
faq.a: You keep the file you downloaded. Change the date, the voice, or the offer in the editor, and use the scene again for the next holiday.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Open the product page and use that photo as the gift in the scene. If the page photo is too tight, upload the clear shot you already sell with.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from here?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file, or send it to the feed you already sell on.

faq.q: Can my own tools request holiday ads?
faq.a: Yes. Your tools can ask for a holiday ad from a product link through the API. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.

faq.q: What frame should the holiday video use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. A clip can run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Pick a frame: tall 9:16, square 1:1, wide 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Each video is its own run.

faq.q: How do I put an order-by date on the ad?
faq.a: Type the order-by date in the editor. As that date gets closer, you can change it and keep the same gift scene.

faq.q: Can the same script be spoken in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Pick another language for the voice, so shoppers somewhere else hear the gift message in their language.

faq.q: Can I make Mother's Day ads the same way?
faq.a: Yes. Describe a Mother's Day table or a gift scene instead of a winter one, and add that occasion's date after you confirm it.

reviews.h2: How shops build gift guide product images
reviews.lead: Three ways a shop gets the gift scene up before the cutoff is confirmed.

items.t: Have an actor lift the set
items.d: They paste the gift-set page and ask an actor to lift it from the box. The order-by date is typed later, so a new date can keep the same scene.

items.t: Stand a generated actor by the coat
items.d: They keep the coat's color and shape, with an actor next to an open gift. That actor is generated, not a hired customer.

items.t: Keep the candle, change the voice
items.d: They download the candle-and-ribbon scene once. Next weekend they only change the language of the voice and the offer line.

trust.h2: Yours Until the Ad Goes Live
trust.lead: Six facts about the file before a seasonal ad goes out.

items.d: The download carries no AIVideosUGC watermark, so seasonal ads are fine. Each app still has its own rules.

items.t: Know the Spend Before the Job
items.d: You know the spend before you commit, so a holiday push stays on budget. A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
If a job fails, those credits return to the balance on their own.
The product photo and the result stay in your account. Nothing goes public until you share it.

items.t: An AI Avatar, or a Clip of You
items.d: Use an AI avatar from the library, or build the presenter from a short clip of yourself.
A voice, captions, and a track from the music library can sit on the clip. Edit them before the ad goes live.
